notes: New: a Network Registry Inspect screen for each monster, with exact IVs, full move list and everything held.
The Network Registry (formerly the Storage Box) now shows your total monster count.

Capture rework: catching a monster now runs a capture program (Basic Capture.exe, and the pricier Advanced/Hunter/Containment.exe) from the battle screen, with its own CAPTURE.EXE animation. Trap Spheres were converted 1:1 into Basic Capture.exe runs.
Wild encounters open with a quick scan beat before the fight.
